bug_semantics: UsersController::edit (CWE-472) skipped role_id authorization when the caller edited their own user. afterFind/beforeSave only rejected a role outside $validRoles when ACL.getUser()['id'] != $data['id']. An authenticated org/group admin (role_id is in the CakePHP patchEntity field whitelist on POST/PUT) could therefore POST their own edit endpoint with an elevated role_id (community admin/admin) and persist it. organisation_id is also mass-assignable for group/community admins on the same endpoint; the CVE-cited patch is the role_id self-edit bypass. Closures captured $validRoles by value, so the later 'include the current role' mutation never constrained the save path.

reasoning: CVE-2025-66385 is a published MITRE/CIRCL record (not withdrawn) of privilege escalation in Cerebrate UsersController::edit before 1.30: an authenticated user can raise their role by supplying role_id on the user-edit request. The vulnerable mechanism is the self-edit exception grafted onto the existing validRoles checks. Those checks were introduced as a real control in b41b0dd (2022-02-19). On 2023-09-07, 5aefc37 implemented 'allow users to self edit' by (1) skipping the validRoles afterFind/beforeSave failures when the target id equals the caller and (2) adding the caller's current role to the dropdown after the closures were defined. CakePHP edit() only persists listed fields, and org/group admins already had role_id in the POST field list, so the beforeSave skip is a complete CWE-472 privilege-escalation primitive: self-POST an admin role_id and it is saved. The later $validRoles self-role insert cannot close that hole because PHP closures capture $validRoles by value. Line history and parent-tree inspection show 5aefc37 is the smallest first-write: its parent still has unconditional validRoles checks, the commit is not a move/revert/squash, and later 04322b2 only added fields/isset guards while copying the same self-id conjunct. The advisory fix c9bfa90 (also duplicated as 3f9fdb5 on develop) deletes the self-id conjunct and moves the current-role insert before the closures so self-edit of the existing role still works. c9bfa90 is the CVE-referenced SHA and the only UsersController change on v1.29..v1.30; it is absent from v1.29 and present in v1.30, matching 'affected < 1.30'. AI attribution is BIC-only: 5aefc37 is authored and committed by human maintainer Sami Mokaddem with a GPG signature and no commit-object AI trailers or bot identity, so the verdict is NOT_AI.
